discovery: DSA-CP is NOT the problem. The mxllm-c4 reference runs with enable_dsa_cp=true on P node and works fine. The issue is that the model ALWAYS selects NATIVE preprocessing, never PROLOG_V3, regardless of DSA-CP setting.

evidence.mxllm_c4_reference_P_node: enable_dsa_cp: true, works fine, normal C4 serving
evidence.our_production_D_node: enable_dsa_cp: false, still selects AscendSFADSACPImpl with NATIVE
evidence.conclusion: The model's default implementation path is ALWAYS NATIVE preprocessing with AscendSFADSACPImpl. PROLOG_V3 (fused) is never selected in this deployment. Our ring write in PROLOG_V3 will never execute.

key_insight: In the NATIVE path, the pre-quantization BF16/FP32 values EXIST IN GM between separate operators (RMSNorm op → GM output → quantization op reads from GM). This means a STANDALONE kernel can read from GM without modifying any existing kernel.

native_path_data_flow.step_2: RMSNorm op → reads from GM, writes BF16/FP32 result to GM ← THIS IS WHERE THE RING WRITE SHOULD READ FROM
native_path_data_flow.step_3: RoPE op → reads from GM, writes result to GM
native_path_data_flow.step_4: Quantization op (MXFP4) → reads BF16 from GM, writes MXFP4 to cache
native_path_data_flow.implication: Pre-quantization BF16 values are IN GM at step 2-3 boundary. A standalone ring writer kernel can read them without any kernel modification.

recommended_pivot.abandon: PROLOG_V3 integration (wrong path, will never execute in production)
recommended_pivot.how: 1. Find the GM tensor that holds the RMSNorm output (pre-quantization BF16) in the NATIVE path. 2. Launch our already-validated standalone ring writer kernel to read from this GM tensor and write to the ring. 3. No existing kernel needs modification. 4. Works with DSA-CP (no conflict). 5. Works with the production AscendSFADSACPImpl.
advantages: No kernel modification needed (zero risk to existing serving)
Uses already-validated ring writer smoke kernel (DEVICE_RING_WRITER_VALIDATED)
Simpler than PROLOG integration (no TBE, no VEC guards, no kernel changes)
